title: Makefile
label: Makefile
desc: Describe builds as rules and variables, and let make rebuild only what changed.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install GNU Make, confirm the version and inspect the defaults it ships with.

snippets.code:
# GNU Make is usually present already
make --version

# Debian and Ubuntu
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y make

# macOS Command Line Tools ship make 3.81
xcode-select --install

# Homebrew installs current GNU Make as gmake
brew install make
gmake --version

# Built-in compiler and flag variables, with no Makefile involved
make -p -f /dev/null | grep -E '^(CC|CXX|CFLAGS|RM) '

# The shell make uses for recipe lines
make -p -f /dev/null | grep '^SHELL '

# The binary a project actually invokes
command -v make

sections.title: Syntax
sections.description: Rules pair a target with prerequisites, and every recipe line starts with a tab.

snippets.code:
# target: prerequisites, then tab-indented recipe lines
app: app.o util.o
	cc -o app app.o util.o

app.o: app.c
	cc -Wall -Wextra -c app.c

# A backslash joins recipe lines into one shell command
docs:
	pandoc README.md \
		--output README.pdf

# Each recipe line gets its own shell, so state does not carry over
install: app
	mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && \
	cp app /usr/local/bin/app

# @ silences the command, - ignores a non-zero exit status
check:
	@echo "checking the binary"
	-test -x app

sections.title: Variables
sections.description: Assign with =, :=, ?= and +=, then expand values with $(NAME).

snippets.code:
# Recursive: expanded every time it is used
CFLAGS = -Wall -Wextra

# Simple: expanded once, right now
BUILD_DIR := build

# Conditional: keep an environment or command-line value
PREFIX ?= /usr/local

# Append to the existing value
CFLAGS += -O2

app: src/main.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $(BUILD_DIR)/app src/main.c

# Target-specific value, visible only while building debug
debug: CFLAGS += -g -O0
debug: app
	@echo "debug build $(GIT_REV)"

# Shell output at parse time versus at use time
GIT_REV := $(shell git rev-parse --short HEAD)
BUILD_DATE = $(shell date +%Y-%m-%d)

# Export to the environment of every recipe
export DATABASE_URL = postgres://localhost/cheatrs

sections.title: Targets
sections.description: Choose the default goal, build several goals and control jobs and output.

snippets.code:
# The first target in the file is the default goal
make

# Several goals, processed left to right
make clean build test

# Four recipes at a time, then a dry run of install
make -j4 build
make -n install

# The first target is the default one
all: build test

build:
	cargo build --release

test: build
	cargo test --release

# State the default goal explicitly so order can change
.DEFAULT_GOAL := all

# GNU Make uses /bin/sh by default; bash adds arrays and [[ ]]
SHELL := /bin/bash

# Run every recipe line in a single shell
.ONESHELL:

release:
	VERSION=$$(git describe --tags --always)
	tar -czf cheatrs-$$VERSION.tar.gz target/release/cheatrs

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.description: Prerequisites set the build order and decide when a target is out of date.

snippets.code:
# The link step waits for both objects
app: main.o util.o
	$(CC) -o app main.o util.o

# Each object also depends on the shared header
main.o: main.c util.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c main.c

util.o: util.c util.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c util.c

# Normal prerequisite: rebuild when config.h changes
# Order-only after |: create build/ once, never rebuild because of it
build/app: src/main.c | build
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o build/app src/main.c

build:
	mkdir -p build

# Ask the compiler which headers each source includes
cc -MM src/main.c

# Save the generated rules and include them from the Makefile
cc -MM src/main.c > build/main.d

sections.title: Pattern Rules
sections.description: Use % stems to build whole families of files with a single rule.

snippets.code:
# % captures the stem: build/main.o comes from src/main.c
build/%.o: src/%.c
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

# $@ target, $< first prerequisite, $^ all prerequisites
app: build/main.o build/util.o
	$(CC) -o $@ $^

# Static pattern: fixed target list, stem still comes from %
OBJECTS := build/main.o build/util.o

$(OBJECTS): build/%.o: src/%.c include/%.h
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -Iinclude -c $< -o $@

# Old suffix rule, equivalent to the %.o: %.c pattern
.SUFFIXES: .c .o

.c.o:
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

sections.title: Functions
sections.description: Text functions shape file lists before any recipe runs.

snippets.code:
# Discover sources, then map them to object paths
SOURCES := $(wildcard src/*.c)
OBJECTS := $(patsubst src/%.c,build/%.o,$(SOURCES))

# The same mapping with a substitution reference
OBJECTS := $(SOURCES:src/%.c=build/%.o)

app: $(OBJECTS)
	$(CC) -o $@ $^

# Add a directory and swap the extension
OBJECTS := $(patsubst %.c,%.o,$(addprefix build/,$(notdir $(SOURCES))))

# One directory per module
MODULES := auth billing search
DIRS := $(foreach m,$(MODULES),cmd/$(m))

# Filter by pattern and sort the result
C_SOURCES := $(filter %.c,$(SOURCES))
HEADERS := $(sort $(wildcard include/*.h))

# Shell runs once at parse time when assigned with :=
DATE := $(shell date +%Y%m%d)
SOURCES := $(shell find src -name '*.c' | sort)

# $(call) reuses a recipe fragment with positional arguments
define compile
$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $(1) -o $(2)
endef

build/app.o:
	$(call compile,src/app.c,build/app.o)

sections.title: Phony Targets
sections.description: Declare command targets phony so a file with the same name cannot satisfy them.

snippets.code:
# These names are commands, not build artifacts
.PHONY: all build test clean install

all: build

build:
	cargo build --release

test: build
	cargo test --release

clean:
	cargo clean

install: build
	install -m 0755 target/release/cheatrs /usr/local/bin/cheatrs

# Without .PHONY, a file called test would block this target
.PHONY: test
test:
	cargo test

# A force target makes a file rule run every time
.PHONY: FORCE
FORCE:

config.yml: FORCE
	./scripts/render-config.sh > $@

sections.title: Includes
sections.description: Split the build into fragments and pull them in with include or -include.

snippets.code:
# Required fragments: make stops when the file is missing
include config.mk
include platform/linux.mk

# Optional local overrides, silently skipped when absent
-include local.mk

# config.mk: values shared by every target
CC := clang
CFLAGS := -Wall -Wextra -O2
PREFIX := /usr/local

# Guard against parsing the same fragment twice
ifndef CONFIG_MK
CONFIG_MK := 1
include config.mk
endif

# Every makefile read so far, in order
$(info parsed: $(MAKEFILE_LIST))

# Rebuild and restart make when the template changes
Makefile: Makefile.in
	./configure

sections.title: Common Recipes
sections.description: Ready targets for C, Rust and release packaging.

snippets.code:
CC := cc
CFLAGS := -Wall -Wextra -O2 -MMD -MP
SRC := $(wildcard src/*.c)
OBJ := $(SRC:src/%.c=build/%.o)

app: $(OBJ)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^

build/%.o: src/%.c
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

# Header dependencies written by -MMD
-include $(OBJ:.o=.d)

.PHONY: all build test fmt lint clean

all: build

build:
	cargo build --release

test:
	cargo test --all-targets

fmt:
	cargo fmt --all

lint:
	cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

clean:
	cargo clean

VERSION := $(shell git describe --tags --always)
ARCH := $(shell uname -m)
DIST := dist/cheatrs-$(VERSION)-$(ARCH)

.PHONY: dist

dist: build
	mkdir -p $(DIST)
	install -m 0755 target/release/cheatrs $(DIST)/cheatrs
	tar -czf $(DIST).tar.gz -C dist $(notdir $(DIST))
